## Graph Traversal

- Breadth-first search uses a FIFO queue to visit nodes level by level.

## Complexity Basics

- Binary search runs in O(log n).
- Merge sort runs in O(n log n).

Q: Which data structure does breadth-first search use?
A: A FIFO queue.

Q: What is the time complexity of binary search?
A: O(log n).

Q: Which traversal explores one branch fully before backtracking?
A: Depth-first search.
